circles.name: The Peninsula
circles.note: The kingdoms of the north and the ṭāʾifas of the frontier: the marches of Book V.

circles.name: The Maghrib
circles.note: The Muslim West across the water: the Marīnids twice beaten, Tlemcen their fief, the Ḥafṣids of Tunis.

circles.name: The Mashriq
circles.note: The Muslim East: the Mamlūk sultan, Granada's one ally, and the Ottomans who have taken Constantinople.

circles.name: The Lands of the Franks
circles.note: Latin Christendom beyond the Pyrenees and across the sea: the war of France and England, the Emperor, the Pope and the cities of Italy.

circles.name: The Land of the Blacks
circles.note: Beyond the Sahara, where the gold comes from: the mansā of Mālī.

farCapitals._note: Capitals beyond the wide chart's frame, in its coordinates (game pixels from its top-left corner), measured from the game's locations.png.
